required_findings.criteria: Treats ADA Title II, ADA Title III, and Section 508 as different legal contexts instead of one universal mobile-app rule.
Identifies WCAG 2.1 Level AA as the current Title II technical standard for covered state and local government web content and mobile apps, without generalizing it to every app.
Requires applicable Section 508 software, interoperability, functional-performance, and content requirements to be evaluated instead of reducing the review to WCAG alone.
Requests the entity type, procurement or federal context, service, jurisdiction, exceptions, contract, and controlling rule before making a legal claim.
Rejects automated scanning as proof of compliance and requires release- and surface-specific evidence, including third-party flows and manual assistive-technology testing.

forbidden_claims: States that every United States mobile app is governed by the same rule
States that ADA Title II or Section 508 universally requires WCAG 2.2
Treats Section 508 as only a WCAG checklist
Guarantees current or future compliance from an automated scan
